com.github.miachm.sods

Class ChartSeries

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.github.miachm.sods.ChartSeries

  • public class ChartSeries
extends Object
    Represents a series within a Chart. A series is a single dataset plotted in the chart. It can be defined by explicit values/labels or by range addresses that point to sheet cells.

    • Method Detail

      • getValuesRangeAddress

        public String getValuesRangeAddress()
        Returns the A1 range address for values. This address points to the cells that provide the numeric values for the series.
        Returns:
        The values range address.

      • getLabelRangeAddress

        public String getLabelRangeAddress()
        Returns the A1 range address for labels. This address points to the cells that provide labels for the series.
        Returns:
        The label range address.

      • getValues

        public List<Object> getValues()
        Returns the series values. This list represents the values explicitly associated with the series, which may be used when no range address is provided.
        Returns:
        An unmodifiable list of values.

      • getLabels

        public List<Object> getLabels()
        Returns the series labels. This list represents the labels explicitly associated with the series, which may be used when no range address is provided.
        Returns:
        An unmodifiable list of labels.

      • getStyle

        public ChartStyle getStyle()
        Returns the series style. The style controls how this series is rendered (colors, markers, text). It's safe to manipulate the returned style since it is a copy. Call setStyle(ChartStyle) to apply changes.
        Returns:
        A copy of the series style.

      • setStyle

        public void setStyle(ChartStyle style)
        Sets the series style. The provided style is copied, so subsequent changes to the input object do not affect the series.
        Parameters:
        style - The series style.

      • getValuesRangeObject

        public Range getValuesRangeObject()
        Resolves the values range address into a Range. This is a convenience method that uses the parent chart's sheet to resolve the range.
        Returns:
        The values range, or null if it cannot be resolved.

      • setValuesRangeAddress

        public void setValuesRangeAddress(String valuesRangeAddress)
        Sets the A1 range address for values. The address should reference the cells that contain the series values.
        Parameters:
        valuesRangeAddress - The values range address.

      • setLabelRangeAddress

        public void setLabelRangeAddress(String labelRangeAddress)
        Sets the A1 range address for labels. The address should reference the cells that contain series labels.
        Parameters:
        labelRangeAddress - The label range address.

      • addValue

        public void addValue(Object value)
        Adds a value to the series. Values added here are used when no values range is provided.
        Parameters:
        value - The value to add.

      • addLabel

        public void addLabel(Object label)
        Adds a label to the series. Labels added here are used when no label range is provided.
        Parameters:
        label - The label to add.
